pages.home.hero_title: Play your way through high-school physics.
pages.home.hero_sub: Every topic is a small game. Rotate, drag, aim — and understand. The exercise is both the lesson and the test.
pages.home.how_lede: Every exercise carries you from the first glimpse to real understanding — the exercise is both the lesson and the test.
pages.home.how_observe_desc: See the phenomenon. Move things around. Notice what stays true.
pages.home.how_experiment_desc: Use the concept to solve a small challenge — with the beam still visible.
pages.home.how_evaluate_desc: Prove you understood. No hints, no beam. Just the law you learned.
pages.home.teach_body: A dedicated space for teachers to assign these exercises and follow a whole class is on the way.

pages.pricing.title: One catalog, one price.
pages.pricing.lede: All 125 exercises, every level, every specialty — unlocked for the period you choose. One-time purchase, no auto-renew.

pages.pricing.custom_pitch: You pick when it ends — we keep every exercise, every pattern, every level unlocked all the way to your date. No auto-renew, no surprises. Aim for exam week, or the whole school year.
pages.pricing.bac_body: Every chapter of your specialty's physics program, drilled through interactive exercises. Every pattern, every lab reasoning — from mechanics to atomic physics — before June.
